messages.english: The last of your unstable energy dissipates and you return to your previous form.
messages.translation: 最后一丝不稳定能量消散了，你恢复了原先的形态。

messages.english: You feel the transmutational energy in your body is nearly expended.
messages.translation: 你感觉体内的变形能量即将耗尽。

messages.english: You raise your head to howl, but no sound comes out.
messages.translation: 你仰头试图嚎叫，却发不出声音。

messages.english: You let out a blood-chilling howl!
messages.translation: 你发出令人胆寒的嚎叫！
火焰烧灼并封住了伤口！

messages.english: You draw in some of the released energy.
messages.translation: 你吸收了部分释放出的能量。

messages.english: Your divine stamina protects you from poison!
messages.translation: 神圣体魄保护你免受毒素侵害！

messages.english: A spider bursts forth from the wound!
messages.translation: 一只蜘蛛从伤口中钻了出来！

messages.english: You emit a cloud of foul miasma!
messages.translation: 你释放出一团污秽瘴气！

messages.english: You can't carry that many items.
messages.translation: 你无法携带这么多物品。

messages.english: There are no objects that can be picked up here.
messages.translation: 这里没有可拾取的物品。

messages.english: Unfortunately, you learned nothing new or useful.
messages.translation: 遗憾的是，你没有学到任何新的或有用的知识。

messages.english: You have collected all the runes! Now go and win!
messages.translation: 你已集齐所有符文！现在去赢得胜利吧！

messages.english: You've emptied out Pandemonium! Nothing left here but demons.
messages.translation: 你已搜刮完魔窟！这里只有恶魔了。

messages.english: Press } to see all the runes you have collected.
messages.translation: 按 } 查看你已收集的全部符文。

messages.english: You feel the abyssal rune guiding you out of this place.
messages.translation: 你感觉深渊符文正指引你离开这里。

messages.english: Press } and ! to see all the gems you have collected.
messages.translation: 按 }，再按 !，查看你已收集的全部宝石。

messages.english: You pick up the Orb of Zot!
messages.translation: 你拾起了 佐特宝珠！

messages.english: Zot can harm you no longer.
messages.translation: 佐特再也无法伤害你了。

messages.english: That is permanently installed in your exoskeleton.
messages.translation: 它永久安装在你的外骨骼上。

messages.english: You will have to take that off first.
Too many items on this level, not dropping the item.
messages.translation: 本层物品太多，无法丢下这件物品。

messages.english: Sorry, no books on that skill today.
messages.translation: 抱歉，今天没有关于该技能的书。

messages.english: That parchment doesn't seem to exist.
messages.translation: 那张羊皮纸似乎不存在。

messages.english: You are unable to access your magic!

messages.translation: 某种力量干扰了你的魔法！

messages.english: Magical energy flows into your mind!
messages.translation: 魔法能量涌入你的脑海！

messages.english: Confirm with . or Enter, or press ? or * to list all spells.
messages.translation: 按 . 或 Enter 确认，按 ? 或 * 列出全部法术。

messages.english: You can't see any susceptible monsters within range! (Use <w>Z</w> to cast anyway.)
messages.translation: 你看不到范围内有可受此法术影响的怪物！（仍要施法请按 <w>Z</w>。）

messages.english: You lose access to your magic!
Sorry, this spell works on others only.
messages.translation: 抱歉，这个法术只能对他者施放。
恶意的能量在你周围涌动。

messages.english: You stop channelling waves of flame.
You stop channelling your searing ray.

messages.translation: 尚未充足的电荷无害地消散了。

messages.english: You stop assembling your clockwork bee.
That is beyond the maximum range.
You call forth a pillar of damnation!
A swirling arc of seething chaos appears!
messages.translation: 一道旋转翻涌的混沌弧光出现了！

messages.english: Bitter cold erupts, blasting rock from the ceiling!
messages.translation: 刺骨严寒爆发，将岩石从天花板上轰落！

messages.english: An iron grate is ripped into pieces!

messages.translation: 一声猛烈的碎裂冲击响起！
你的火焰抗性被烧掉了！

messages.english: You erupt in a fountain of uncontrolled magic!
messages.translation: 失控的魔法从你身上喷涌而出！

messages.english: You feel like your blood is boiling!
messages.translation: 你感觉血液仿佛在沸腾！

messages.english: The poison in your system burns terribly!
messages.translation: 你体内的毒素猛烈燃烧起来！

messages.english: The poison in your system burns!
messages.translation: 你体内的毒素燃烧起来！

messages.english: The air crackles with electrical energy.
You reach out to the water around you and turn it against your foes!
messages.translation: 你操纵周围的水，让它们攻向你的敌人！

messages.english: You exhale a blast of multi-hued devastation!
messages.translation: 你吐出一股色彩斑斓的毁灭气息！

messages.english: You begin to radiate toxic energy.
Your toxic radiance grows in intensity.
messages.translation: 你的剧毒辐射变得更强了。

messages.english: Poisonous fumes billow in the air!
Your wave of flame reaches its maximum intensity and dissipates.
messages.translation: 你的火焰波达到最大强度后消散了。

messages.english: You finish channelling your searing ray.
messages.translation: 你完成了灼热射线的引导。

messages.english: A cannonade of hail descends around you!
messages.translation: 密集的冰雹轰落在你周围！

messages.english: You erupt in a blast of force!
messages.translation: 一股强大的冲击从你身上爆发！

messages.english: There are no walls around you to affect.
messages.translation: 你周围没有可影响的墙壁。

messages.english: The walls around you are covered in ice.
messages.translation: 你周围的墙壁覆上了冰霜。

messages.english: You can't see anything to vaporise!
messages.translation: 你看不到可汽化的目标！

messages.english: Your charge dissipates without a target.
messages.translation: 由于没有目标，你积聚的电荷消散了。

messages.english: There are no places for you to create a bog.
messages.translation: 没有适合你创造沼泽的地方。

messages.english: You conjure up an array of volatile reagents!
messages.translation: 你造出一组不稳定的试剂！

messages.english: Your magical reserves are too exhausted to conjure more reagents.
messages.translation: 你的魔力储备太过匮乏，无法造出更多试剂。

messages.english: Flasks of reagents rain from above!
messages.translation: 试剂瓶从上方如雨落下！
你释放出满怀怨恨的亡者！

messages.english: The last of your harvested death is exhausted.
messages.translation: 你收集的死亡能量已全部耗尽。

messages.english: You have harvested as much death for Grave Claw as you can hold at once.
messages.translation: 你为坟墓之爪收集的死亡能量已达储存上限。

messages.english: You have harvested enough death to cast Grave Claw an additional time.
messages.translation: 你收集的死亡能量足以额外施放一次坟墓之爪。

messages.english: You steady yourself in place and focus your resilience into a mighty blast.
messages.translation: 你站稳脚步，将坚韧之力凝聚成一次强大的冲击。

messages.english: Your familiar is too far away to imbue with magic.
messages.translation: 你的魔宠离得太远，无法为其灌注魔力。

messages.english: You call for your canine familiar and it appears with a howl!
messages.translation: 你呼唤犬类魔宠，它伴着嚎叫现身！

messages.english: You imbue your familiar with magical energy and its fangs glint viciously.
messages.translation: 你为魔宠灌注魔法能量，它的獠牙闪出凶光。

messages.english: A prickly colossus appears in a rush of desert wind.
messages.translation: 一个遍身尖刺的巨像在沙漠狂风中现身。

messages.english: A chill wind blows around you.
messages.translation: 一阵寒风在你周围吹起。

messages.english: You call out to the draconic realm, and the dragon horde roars back!
messages.translation: 你呼唤巨龙的国度，群龙以咆哮回应！

messages.english: A dragon tries to answer your call, but you don't have enough magical power!
messages.translation: 一条巨龙试图回应你的呼唤，但你的魔力不足！

messages.english: A dragon arrives to answer your call!
messages.translation: 一条巨龙应你的呼唤而来！

messages.english: A mana viper appears with a sibilant hiss.
messages.translation: 一条法力蝰蛇嘶鸣着现身。

messages.english: You are momentarily dazzled by a brilliant light.
messages.translation: 一道耀眼的光芒令你短暂目眩。

messages.english: You can't see a target there!
An electric hum fills the air.
messages.translation: 空气中充满电流的嗡鸣。

messages.english: You bind the heart of a blast furnace in slag iron.
messages.translation: 你将高炉的核心束缚在炉渣铁中。

messages.english: A tiny devil pulls itself out of the air.
messages.translation: 一只小魔鬼从空气中钻了出来。

messages.english: Somewhere, a butterfly flaps its wings.
messages.translation: 某处，一只蝴蝶扇动了翅膀。

messages.english: You hear the flapping of tiny wings.
messages.translation: 你听见微小翅膀的扑动声。

messages.english: Wisps of shadow whirl around you...
messages.translation: 缕缕暗影在你周围盘旋……
暗影消散了，没有产生任何效果。

messages.english: The dungeon shakes, a horrible noise fills the air, and a portal to some otherworldly place is opened!
messages.translation: 地下城震动，可怕的声音充斥着空气，一扇通往异界的传送门打开了！

messages.english: You open a gateway and unleash terrible monstrosities upon the world.
messages.translation: 你打开一道门户，将可怕的怪物释放到世间。

messages.english: A forested plane collides here with a resounding crunch!
messages.translation: 一个森林位面伴着震耳的撞击声，与这里相交！

messages.english: An evil force gathers, but it quickly dissipates.
messages.translation: 一股邪恶力量聚起，却很快消散。

messages.english: You cannot haunt those who bear you no hostility.
messages.translation: 你不能对不怀敌意的生物施放鬼魂缠身。

messages.english: You call forth a shade to shield your allies.
messages.translation: 你召出一道幽影，保护你的盟友。

messages.english: You recall your battlesphere and imbue it with additional charge.
messages.translation: 你召回作战球，并为其补充能量。

messages.english: You imbue your battlesphere with additional charge.
You conjure a globe of magical energy.
messages.translation: 你造出一颗魔法能量球。

messages.english: Your battlesphere expends the last of its energy and dissipates.
messages.translation: 你的作战球耗尽最后的能量，消散了。

messages.english: Your battlesphere wavers and loses cohesion.
messages.translation: 你的作战球摇晃着散开了。

messages.english: You feel your bond with your battlesphere wane.
messages.translation: 你感觉与作战球的联系正在减弱。

messages.english: You can't conjure that within a solid object!
messages.translation: 你不能在实体物体内部造出它！

messages.english: You can't place the prism on a creature.
messages.translation: 你不能把棱镜放在生物身上。

messages.english: You call forth a plague of scarabs!
A briar patch grows up from the ground.
messages.translation: 一片荆棘丛从地上长了出来。

messages.english: Something you can't see blocks your briars from growing!
messages.translation: 你看不见的某物阻碍了荆棘生长！

messages.english: You can't grow a ballistomycete there.
messages.translation: 你不能在那里培育弹道真菌。

messages.english: Something you can't see occupies that space!
messages.translation: 你看不见的某物占据了那个位置！

messages.english: A ballistomycete grows from the ground.
messages.translation: 一株弹道真菌从地上长了出来。

messages.english: You can't grow an oklob plant there.
messages.translation: 你不能在那里培育奥克罗布植物。

messages.english: Something you can't see is occupying that space!
messages.translation: 你看不见的某物正占据着那个位置！

messages.english: An oklob plant grows from the ground.
messages.translation: 一株奥克罗布植物从地上长了出来。

messages.english: There is not enough space to conjure foxfire!
messages.translation: 没有足够空间造出狐火！

messages.english: There's no space to create foxfire here.
messages.translation: 这里没有空间造出狐火。
那里已经有看不见的东西了！

messages.english: You can't make simulacra of that!
Something prevents your mortar from forming!
messages.translation: 某物阻止了你的迫击炮成形！

messages.english: There's no room for the soul wisp to form!
messages.translation: 没有空间让灵魂幽火成形！

messages.english: You continue winding your clockwork bee...
messages.translation: 你继续为发条蜜蜂上弦……

messages.english: Without a target, your clockwork bee falls to the ground.
messages.translation: 由于没有目标，你的发条蜜蜂落到了地上。

messages.english: Without a target and with nowhere to land, your clockwork bee falls apart in a shower of cogs and coils.
messages.translation: 由于没有目标，也无处着陆，你的发条蜜蜂散成了一阵齿轮与弹簧雨。
你的发条蜜蜂未能部署！

messages.english: You see nothing there to target.
messages.translation: 你看不到那里有可选定的目标。

messages.english: Your bee can only target hostiles.
messages.translation: 你的发条蜜蜂只能以敌对生物为目标。
你已有的发条蜜蜂散架了。

messages.english: If you tried to rewind gears in your present state, you'd only break them.
messages.translation: 以你现在的状态尝试重新上弦，只会弄坏齿轮。

messages.english: You need a visible target to rewind your bee! (Use ctrl+direction or * direction to deconstruct it instead.)
messages.translation: 你需要一个可见目标才能为发条蜜蜂重新上弦！（使用 ctrl+方向键 或 * 方向键可将其拆解。）

messages.english: You lack sufficient magical power to recharge your bee.
messages.translation: 你没有足够魔力为发条蜜蜂重新充能。

messages.english: You try to forge sawblades, but something it already there!
messages.translation: 你试图锻造锯刃，但那里已经有东西了！

messages.english: You forge a whirling saw of razor-sharp crystal.
messages.translation: 你锻造出一片飞旋的锋利水晶锯刃。

messages.english: You forge whirling saws of razor-sharp crystal.
messages.translation: 你锻造出数片飞旋的锋利水晶锯刃。

messages.english: Something unseen prevents your spell from working!
messages.translation: 某个看不见的东西阻止了你的法术生效！

messages.english: Your paragon expends all of its energy in an overwhelming flurry of blows!
messages.translation: 你的白金典范倾尽能量，发动了一连串压倒性的攻击！

messages.english: You craft a gleaming metal champion and it leaps into the fray!
messages.translation: 你铸造出一位闪亮的金属勇士，它随即跃入战团！
你的白金典范与你一同攻击！

messages.english: Your paragon has reached its maximum power!
messages.translation: 你的白金典范已达到最大力量！

messages.english: Your paragon is now ready to unleash a masterful attack.
messages.translation: 你的白金典范已准备好发动精妙的攻击。

messages.english: A lumbering aparatus takes shape within a cloud of fumes.
messages.translation: 一台笨重的装置在烟雾中成形。

messages.english: The potion freezes solid before it can reach you!
messages.translation: 药水还未到你面前，就冻成了固体！

messages.english: You sigh wistfully at the memory of the taste.
messages.translation: 你回味着那种滋味，惆怅地叹了口气。

messages.english: You construct a shell of ice in front of yourself.
messages.translation: 你在面前构筑了一枚冰壳。

messages.english: A rock-encrusted egg appears nearby and begins to stir.
messages.translation: 一枚岩石包裹的蛋在附近出现，开始晃动。

messages.english: You forge a skittering defender to stand by your side.
messages.translation: 你锻造出一个疾行的守卫，护卫在你身旁。

messages.english: You condense your magic into a crackling blade!
messages.translation: 你将魔力凝聚成一柄噼啪作响的利刃！

messages.english: You can't draw power from your own body while in death's door.
messages.translation: 处于死亡之门状态时，你无法从自身躯体中汲取力量。

messages.english: Your attempt to draw power from your own body fails.
messages.translation: 你试图从自身躯体中汲取力量，但失败了。

messages.english: You draw magical energy from your own body!
messages.translation: 你从自身躯体中汲取魔法能量！

messages.english: Malign forces permeate your being, awaiting release.
messages.translation: 恶意力量浸透你的全身，等待释放。

messages.english: You dismiss your zombies and call upon the dead to rise afresh.
messages.translation: 你遣散已有的丧尸，呼唤亡者重新起身。

messages.english: You call upon the dead to rise.
Nothing appears to have answered your call.
messages.translation: 似乎没有什么回应你的呼唤。

messages.english: You attempt to intoxicate your foes!
messages.translation: 你试图让敌人陷入醉乱！
你周围的世界天旋地转！

messages.english: There was nowhere nearby to inscribe sigils!
messages.translation: 附近没有可铭刻符印的地方！

messages.english: You inscribe a pair of binding sigils.
messages.translation: 你铭刻了一对束缚符印。
你铭刻了一枚束缚符印。

messages.english: You slip past the binding sigil.
You move over the binding sigil and are bound in place!
messages.translation: 你走过束缚符印，被束缚在原地！

messages.english: You shape a spike launcher from a nearby wall.
messages.translation: 你用附近的墙壁塑造出一座尖刺发射器。

messages.english: Your spike launcher falls apart as you grow too distant to maintain it.
messages.translation: 你离得太远，无法维持尖刺发射器，它散架了。
你的尖刺发射器散架了。

messages.english: You feel jittery for a moment.
messages.translation: 你短暂地感到一阵不安。

messages.english: You tried to hop, but there was no room to land!
messages.translation: 你试图跳跃，却没有落脚的空间！

messages.english: You are hurled out of the way!
You charge forward in eerie silence!
messages.translation: 你在诡异的寂静中向前冲锋！

messages.english: You charge forward with an electric crackle!
messages.translation: 你伴着噼啪电光向前冲锋！

messages.english: You feel the Orb interfering with your translocation!
messages.translation: 你感觉宝珠正干扰你的位移！

messages.english: Oops! There was something there already!
messages.translation: 糟了！那里已经有东西了！

messages.english: You feel space start to destabilise around you!
messages.translation: 你感觉周围的空间开始变得不稳定！

messages.english: You feel a distressing malevolence running through your instability!
messages.translation: 你感觉不稳定之中流淌着令人不安的恶意！

messages.english: You feel the power of the Abyss delaying your translocation!
messages.translation: 你感觉深渊之力正延缓你的位移！

messages.english: You feel the Orb delaying your translocation!
messages.translation: 你感觉宝珠正延缓你的位移！

messages.english: Your surroundings flicker for a moment.
messages.translation: 周围的景象闪烁了一下。
周围的景象似乎略有不同。

messages.english: You can't see anything to attack.
messages.translation: 你看不到可攻击的目标。

messages.english: You can't see anything you can safely attack.
messages.translation: 你看不到能安全攻击的目标。

messages.english: Space momentarily warps into an impossible shape!
messages.translation: 空间瞬间扭曲成不可能的形状！

messages.english: You don't see anything to apport there.
messages.translation: 你看不到那里有可摄取的物品。

messages.english: Not with that terrain in the way!
messages.translation: 那里的地形挡住了去路！

messages.english: A magic seal in the Gauntlet prevents you from opening a passage!
messages.translation: 竞技场中的魔法封印阻止了你开启通道！

messages.english: You can't create a passage there!
messages.translation: 你无法在那里创建通道！

messages.english: You cannot create a passage on the other side of the transparent wall.
messages.translation: 你无法在透明墙壁的另一侧创建通道。

messages.english: Creating a passage of Golubria requires sufficient empty space.
messages.translation: 创建格鲁布里亚通道需要足够的空地。

messages.english: The air shimmers briefly around you.
messages.translation: 你周围的空气短暂地闪烁。

messages.english: You speak a word of chaos!
You see nothing there to target!
messages.translation: 你看不到那里有可选定的目标！

messages.english: Space begins to contract around you, but something blocks your path.
messages.translation: 你周围的空间开始收缩，但某物挡住了你的去路。

messages.english: %s is burned by your cloak of flames.
%s erupts in a fountain of uncontrolled magic!
%s conjures a globe of magical energy!
%s finishes brewing potions and dispenses them!
messages.translation: %s完成了药水酿制，并将其分发出去！

messages.english: %s moves over the binding sigil and is bound in place!
messages.translation: %s走过束缚符印，被束缚在原地！

messages.english: %s attempts to avoid the deathblow, but fails!
messages.translation: %s试图避开致命一击，却失败了！

messages.english: %s binds the souls of nearby monsters.
%s turns to gold and falls from the air.
%s briefly glints gold and then vanishes.
messages.translation: %s短暂地闪出金光，随后消失了。

messages.english: %s seems to find hidden reserves of power!
%s burns to shimmering ash in your grasp.
You pick up %s and begin reading...
You pick up %s. Unfortunately, it's quite useless to you.
messages.translation: 你拾起了%s。遗憾的是，它对你毫无用处。

messages.english: You pick up %s, but it has nothing more to teach you.
messages.translation: 你拾起了%s，但它已没有更多知识可传授给你。

messages.english: You pick up another %s and continue studying.
